steps.en: Connect an Android phone over USB with ADB debugging on, Douyin open
steps.zh: 用 USB 连上开了 ADB 调试的安卓手机，打开抖音

steps.en: Get Tencent AI AppID/AppKey and set your screen's button coordinates
steps.zh: 申请腾讯 AI 的 AppID/AppKey，填好你屏幕的按钮坐标

steps.en: Install the 2018-pinned requirements and start the loop
steps.zh: 装上 2018 年钉死的依赖，启动循环

steps.en: Screenshots the phone over ADB and compresses it under 1 MB
steps.zh: 通过 ADB 截手机屏，压到 1 MB 以下

steps.en: Sends it to the ai.qq.com face API and reads back age and beauty score
steps.zh: 发给 ai.qq.com 人脸接口，拿回年龄和颜值分

steps.en: Above BEAUTY_THRESHOLD taps like and follow, then swipes to the next video
steps.zh: 超过 BEAUTY_THRESHOLD 就点赞关注，然后划到下一条

value.en: Historically a hands-free swipe-and-like loop; inert today — 2018 coordinates, face API presumed gone
value.zh: 当年是免手动的刷视频点赞循环；今天已失效——坐标停在 2018 年，人脸接口大概率已下线

sources: https://github.com/wangshub/Douyin-Bot#原理 (screenshot, compress < 1MB, ai.qq.com face API, BEAUTY_THRESHOLD, like + follow, next page)
https://github.com/wangshub/Douyin-Bot#使用教程 (AppKey/AppID from ai.qq.com; pip install -r requirements.txt; python douyin-bot.py)
https://github.com/wangshub/Douyin-Bot#注意 (config.json keys center_point, follow_bottom, star_bottom; OnePlus 5 1920x1080)
